title: fix(plugin-approvals): the batch lock read answers a line of a held master as locked

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

Fixes #37041
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表页用户：审批中的报销单、订单等主记录下的明细行，列表里现在也显示为已锁定，不再先打开编辑器、保存时才被拒（与单条记录页一致）。
- 属于审批流程（锁定提示）的修复，替在列表里改明细行的业务用户解决“能点开却存不了”的问题。
- 出错时最坏情况是明细行被误标为锁定或仍显示可编辑，不会写错任何数据；可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做的：本 PR 无需你裁定。行菜单“删除”按钮的取舍（是否说明“被主记录锁住”）已移到 #37151，由席位呈你裁定。

## What changes

- `getRecordLocks` (the batch door `POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks`) now asks the detail-row lock as well as the record lock, so a master-detail line whose master is held by a locking approval answers `locked: true`, exactly as `getRecordLock` already does and as the route doc promises ("Each entry is exactly the single-record door's answer for that id").
- New batch helper `detailRowsHeldByLockingApproval` in `lifecycle-hooks.ts`: one SYSTEM read of the rows' `master_detail` FK columns for the whole page, then one locking-request lookup per `master_detail` edge for every master those rows name. That is `1 + edges` reads whatever the page size, never one per row; an object with no `master_detail` edge reads nothing extra. The one-row `detailRowHeldByLockingApproval` now delegates to it, so the single and batch reads share one judgement. With one id, the FK read keeps the by-id shape the one-row read always sent.
- The answer's shape is unchanged (`{ locked }` or `null`); unreadable-vs-missing stays indistinguishable (the caller's anchor read is untouched and runs first).
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`: one clause in each of the `getRecordLock` and `getRecordLocks` docblocks saying that a master-detail line also answers `true` while the record it belongs to is held (the detail-row lock's judgement). The text "`locked` only", the rest of the #25934 ruling A text and the answer shape are untouched; `check:generated` reports all 14 spec artefacts up to date at 88b76bf8.

### Seat 4's consumer constraint (comment 7145422785): answered by #37151

**Seat ruling (repo:objectstack#3, 2026-11-24 22:53Z): this PR lands the parity fix alone with `Fixes #37041`; the lock-kind question moved to #37151, which carries route A, route B and keep to the maintainer.** The measurements below are kept as that card's evidence.

The constraint asks this PR to say which of (A) the batch entry and the single door say which kind of lock holds the row, or (B) the grid hides Delete on master-held lines. Measured at 517e4153:

**Route A: the ruled text it would change.** The `getRecordLock` docblock in `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts` carries the #25934 ruling A: "**What is answered:** `locked` only. ... ⛔ No request id, node, participants or `pending` flag". A kind field (for example `heldBy: 'record' | 'master'`, master winning when both hold, since a held master refuses the line's delete either way) rewrites "`locked` only" there, the same sentence in the plugin's `getRecordLock` docblock ("`{ locked }` only"), the REST door comment ("the payload is `{ locked }` alone") and the return type of both optional contract members (a published shape, so Clause-② would become `yes (widening)`). Because that is ruled text, this PR stops here and the shape question goes to the seat.

**Route A: what the field would tell a caller who can read the line but not the master.** With parity alone, `locked: true` on a line already says "this line or its master is held", and the single door has said that since it shipped. The kind field adds one bit: which of the two. A caller who may update the line can already learn that bit without a destructive act: an edit is refused `RECORD_LOCKED` with the record lock's sentence (`record_locked`: the line's own object label and title) when the line is held itself, and with the detail-row lock's sentence (`record_locked_untitled`: the MASTER object's label, no title) when its master is held (`lifecycle-hooks.ts`, `recordLockRefusal` called from the two hooks). Delete is offered only to callers who can write, and for them A discloses nothing new. A read-only line reader with no request visibility learns the bit only through A. Nothing about the request (id, node, participants, pending) is disclosed in either case.

**Route B: what the grid can tell without a server field.** The grid has the object schema (it already branches on `master_detail` field types in `ObjectGrid.tsx`). So it can know the object is a detail object, but not why a given row is locked. The only server-free rule is to hide Delete on every locked row of an object that has a `master_detail` field. That over-hides Delete on a line held by a request of its own whose master is not held, which the server would accept (the detail-row hook judges only the master; the record lock is update-only, and the delete-cancel linkage cancels the request). It also copies the server's "which hook refuses delete" rule into the client. Asking the batch door a second time for the masters' ids would need the FK column on the page and a readable master (an unreadable master answers `null`), so it does not close the gap. **Collision:** PR #37128 (#36911, seat 4, open draft at d4f56f4a) edits `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`, so route B can only start after it merges.

**No regression from landing parity alone.** Today the batch door answers master-held lines `locked: false`, so the grid offers both Edit and Delete, and the server refuses both. After this PR (and #37128) it offers Delete only, which the server still refuses. That is one refused offer instead of two. The Delete gap exists already and is not created here.

## Tests

<details><summary>plugin-approvals: targeted file, full suite, typecheck (head 9b5bdcd8)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/record-lock-read.integration.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)` (12 existing + 2 new).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: `Test Files 128 passed (128)`, `Tests 1922 passed (1922)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck`: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- New pins in `record-lock-read.integration.test.ts`:
  - single/batch parity for every caller (submitter, approver, reader) over a record held itself (`held_sheet_a`), a line of a held master (`held_sheet_line_a`), unheld records and lines (`_b`), a missing id and a repeated id. It also covers a line held by its own request, and the unlock once the master's request is decided.
  - a page of 8 lines reads exactly `[line, sys_approval_request, line, sys_approval_request]`, never one read per row.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the tested behaviour)</summary>

The test imports `./approval-service.js` from `src` (no dist hop). `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `{ locked: held.has(id) || heldByMaster.has(id) }` with `{ locked: held.has(id) }`: anchor x1 -> x0, blob 50e23203 -> da6d398c. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 12 passed (14)`, and the two failures are exactly the two new pins. Restored: blob == HEAD (50e23203), `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (batch reports a held master's line as locked, no read per row) and acceptance 2 (a parity pin for held-itself / line-of-held-master / unheld) are both met by the commits here.
- The shape question from seat 4 (route A vs B) is filed as #37151 (maintainer ruling owed); `Fixes #37041` stays, per the seat's ruling.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`, `detailRowsHeldByLockingApproval`: the batch FK read (SYSTEM) and the per-edge master lookup.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, `getRecordLocks`: the second half runs only on readable ids the record lock left unlocked.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/record-lock-read.integration.test.ts`: the two new pins.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/record-lock-read.integration.test.ts` should report 14 passed.
